name: Completion Crosses AY Boundary, Then a New Course Added via PUT
description: SLD POSTs a learner onto ZSC00001 starting 2026-06-01 and already completing 2026-08-31 — the course starts in AY 25/26 but its CompletionDate falls in AY 26/27. Employer approves it. SLD then PUTs (rather than POSTs) a single payload containing both ZSC00001 and a new course, ZSC00002, starting 2027-09-01 with a one-month expected duration and no completion or withdrawal date, via the new-style route with academicYear=2627 and the learnerKey obtained after approval. Employer approves ZSC00002 too. Variant of `ay-future-course-after-completion` — exercises a completion date that itself straddles the AY boundary, and the multi-item PUT array path (rather than a standalone POST) for adding the new course.

steps.name: SLD Creates Short Course 1 (ZSC00001), Completion Crosses into AY 26/27
SLD PUTs ZSC00001 + ZSC00002 (New, Starting Sep 2027) in a Single Payload — new-style URI with academicYear=2627
